title: Koi Dulha Nahi Daikha Jahan Mei Qasim Sa
body:
Jis Ki Baraat Gaee Ore Janaza Louta
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaaq Ore Khoon Say Hain Haath Bharay Syed Kay
Chaanth Ker Rait Say Dhoonda Hai Badan Qasim Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Dar-e-Khayma Pay Kharay Ho Kay Sada Di Shah Nay
Ho Gaee Bayva Tu Kubra Mera Qasim Na Raha
<<DIVIDER>>
Kahien Thak Jao Na Shabeer Ye Tukray Chun Kay
Do Ijazat Kay Chalay Saath Madad Ko Ferwa
<<DIVIDER>>
Aik Shehzaday Ki Baraat Chali Kerbal Say
Kuch Katay Sar Hain Baraati Bibian Bay Parda
<<DIVIDER>>
Poocha Zalim Nay Yahan Kon Hai Maan Qasim Ki
Bola Zalim Kay Kalayjay Pay Jis Ka Haath Dhara
<<DIVIDER>>
Soch Saqlain Kay Kya Bibi Pay Guzri Hogi
Subho Dulhan Thi Bani Shaam Ko Qaidan Kubra
